entityFieldPolicy: All 15 frozen Driver records, 30 RELATED_SEARCH aliases and empty crosswalk list read; definitions, scale, direction, mechanism, indicators, methods, evidence, time/lag/persistence, modifiability, volatility, observability, caveats and narrative fields retained. No blocked local metadata found or repaired. Likelihood versus commitment, trait versus state, task versus goal and outcome versus measure distinctions flagged rather than canonical edits.
rdsReview: No local RDS. All endpoints of the 16 incident propositions are Drivers. PSY-078 in F09 is not targeted; its complete audit belongs to F09. A goal target-performance-gap indicator does not authorize formula-as-causality or Driver reclassification.
causalGateReview: STANDARD_CAUSAL for every current F04 incident edge; exact external-to-F04 Psychological endpoints PSY-077, PSY-110 and PSY-127 reviewed. No RDS direct target, new numerical execution or independent mediator propagation.

layersConsidered.BIO: Sleep-restriction effort study screened; cognitive versus physical reward effort and general motivation separated. No prior BIO pilot change.
layersConsidered.PSY: Need/regulation/goal constructs, emotion and trait-state alternatives assessed; correlated scales and manipulation checks not causal primitives.
layersConsidered.SOC: Provider interaction, normative approval, belonging and peer contact reviewed using earlier F03 evidence; reference/goal context separate.
layersConsidered.CUL: Choice review includes cultural meaning/reference-figure limits; group membership not an exact manipulated culture construct.
layersConsidered.ENV: Nature exposure research concerns intrinsic aspirations, not necessarily task interest; ordinary constraints/shocks considered without fabricated evidence.
layersConsidered.INS: Homework assignment rules and health practitioner autonomy-support research; policy permission is not felt autonomy or efficacy.
layersConsidered.INF: Task alternatives, instructions, rewards/feedback and regret wording; content exposure versus construct change distinct.
layersConsidered.TEC: Gamification registry reused; heterogeneous packages and high-rigor sensitivity prevent generic exact-motivation effects.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Task-option choice, goal assignment, priority prompts and feedback/rewards reviewed; retained one exact operation/effect.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Everyday competing demands, feedback and goal negotiation considered; no exact uncontrolled effect inferred from laboratory results.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Disruption/constraint can force reprioritization, but no exact shock-to-goal construct evidence extracted.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Nature immersion and resource constraints screened; value/aspiration outcomes not renamed intrinsic interest.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Provider rules/assigned homework and support examined; no broad school/work policy efficacy inferred.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Gamification and digital affordances considered; package/component and outcome heterogeneity remain unresolved.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Belonging/relatedness/contact review reused; no social tie or network statistic direct effect target.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Instructions, options, feedback and anticipated consequences considered; no automatic target construct change.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Sleep restriction primary study screened; effort behavior, intrinsic interest and stable reward trait kept distinct.

propertyPolicy: Every Driver and exact incident causal edge considered for all eleven properties. LEVEL only supported where exact scoped evidence exists. Nulls never imply zero; timing/persistence beyond observed assessments unknown. STRUCTURE does not mean editing ontology, replacing a goal list in a scenario, or treating a metric as a target.
relationshipPropertyReview: Exact reviewed causal edges examined for strength/direction/enablement/functional-shape/structure changes. Need/interest SEM and priority-to-intention/behavior moderation cannot be substituted for identified edge-targeted effects. No formal moderation or pathway survives exact target/timing/evidence gate; no B/C overlap or automatic summation.

skepticalReview.method: Separate second-pass falsification after initial evidence funnel: original homework/puzzle methods and null discussion checked, baseline versus randomized analysis separated, canonical source identity/dedup verified, existing polarity/mechanism read without replacement.
checks: Patall 2010 interest/enjoyment subscale separated from other IMI subscales and objective performance.
Randomized Analysis 1 versus baseline correlational Analysis 2; no causal mediation from same-sample path model.
Missingness concentrated among lower achievers, anticipatory crossover and two-unit duration constrain generalization.
Reeve option-choice null retains solver exclusions and composite-measure limits; no equivalence claim.
Patall 2008 includes Reeve 2003, so no false replication count.
Reward syntheses disagree in aggregation/contingencies, not proof universal harm or universal safety.
Regret mechanism is already inaction-qualified in canonical record; proposal clarifies measurement/causal basis, not inventing a missing caveat.
Priority/conflict evidence concerns moderation of enactment, not ordinary priority/conflict-to-intention edge.
SRC160/SRC-501 are one work with metadata discrepancy; SRC109 is framework validation, not a goal-conflict experiment.
Sleep effort and nature aspirations do not map automatically to intrinsic or approach motivation; no trait change.
Family interpretation errors caught before finalization: source IDs resolved mechanically and incorrect draft SRC109 locator replaced; no canonical change.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: One scoped interest EffectAssertion is not general pedagogical advice. Need/goal overlaps require later Family and human review. Canonical source-alignment issues remain; full literature coverage and Layer reconciliation are pending.
